title: Tanh Layer
source_docs: Deep Learning Toolbox/Deep Learning Layers/Activation Layers/Tanh_Layer.md
text: Hyperbolic tangent (tanh) layer, 1 input, 1 output, {Approximation method} sets Approximation method for computing layer output; {Sample time} sets the option to specify sample time. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Approximation method
params.values: Approximation method for computing layer output None (default) | CORDIC | Lookup

params.name: Sample time
params.values: Option to specify sample time -1 (default) | scalar
